title: Fewer search dead ends and easier local AI setup on Linux
summary: I can keep looking for sources when your model’s search comes up short. On supported Linux systems, I can set up local AI without compiling llama.cpp.

highlights.title: Find sources when your model comes up short
highlights.body: I search public sources with Keenable when your model’s search is unavailable or comes up short.

highlights.title: Get local AI running without compiling
highlights.body:
On supported Linux systems with NVIDIA graphics, I install prebuilt llama.cpp `b12823` and the matching CUDA runtime (`cudart`). Setup skips the local build and tries Vulkan if CUDA fails.

| Linux architecture | CUDA build and matching `cudart` |
| --- | --- |
| x64 | CUDA 12.8 |
| ARM64 | CUDA 13.5 |

new: **Added date filters and indexed page reads.** With Keenable, I can find sources from a specific period or read an indexed copy of a public page.
improvements: **Improved local model selection.** I use free GPU memory from llama.cpp when available to choose a model that fits. `llmfit` 1.1.21 skips the Microsoft Basic Render Driver when detecting Vulkan GPUs.

**Replaced Qwen3.8 27B with Inkling 2 Mini for new local setups.** Its mixture-of-experts design aims for faster replies by activating only part of the model per token. I check whether Unsloth’s GGUF weights fit before downloading them.
**Made the activity feed easier to follow.** Connecting lines appear before labels so you can see which actions belong together. The animation respects your reduced-motion setting.
**Made Grok optional.** You can add it for web and social search. Profiles with a Grok API key keep access.
**Shared more about Leon’s long-term vision.** My FYI notes and READMEs explain why I have my own agent loop. A weekly GitHub star chart shows how the project has grown.
**Documented settings and tool results.** Editors can show what configuration and manifest fields control. The computer-use tool documents the fields it returns.
fixes: **Improved large-image copying.** Copy tall screenshots at full resolution, or download the original when an image exceeds the clipboard limit.
**Fixed file reads for line ranges.** I skip extra page requests once I’ve returned the lines you asked for.
**Fixed a CUDA error on long inputs.** llama.cpp `b12823` fixes a GPU launch failure that affected certain operations on inputs over 65,535 tokens.
**Fixed OpenAI replies that contain several large images.** `@ai-sdk/openai` 4.0.125 raises the Responses HTTP limit from 64 MiB to 512 MiB per event so those replies can finish.
**Separated image previews from final results.** AI SDK `ai` 7.0.183 keeps previews out of completed tool results. The provider interface moves to `@ai-sdk/provider` 4.0.39.
**Fixed WebSocket memory exhaustion.** `ws` 8.23.0 closes a vulnerability in OpenAI and Socket.IO connections that could bring down the Leon server.
removed: **Removed local llama.cpp builds.** Managed setup skips CMake and Ninja installs. New managed local AI setups on Linux ARM64 require a supported GPU.
